description.en: Elevated gender-related distress and/or reduced life satisfaction on the GCLS, recorded as a screening finding that needs the diagnostic assessment of gender incongruence/dysphoria.
description.hi: GCLS पर उच्च लिंग-संबंधी कष्ट अथवा कम जीवन-संतुष्टि — एक स्क्रीनिंग प्राप्ति के रूप में अंकित, जिसके लिए लिंग-असंगति/डिस्फोरिया का नैदानिक मूल्यांकन आवश्यक।

icd11Chapter: Chapter 17: Conditions related to sexual health
mappingNote: Screen flag only. GCLS subscale scores describe distress and functioning; the diagnosis of gender incongruence (ICD-11 HA60/HA61/HA6Z) or DSM-5-TR gender dysphoria requires the published criteria met over at least six months, established by clinical assessment. Never record a GCLS score as a diagnosis, and never treat gender diversity itself as disorder.
